memories.content: Use short-lived WAL SQLite connections with busy_timeout=5000 and atomic closes to avoid file locks during concurrent Windows/Linux sessions.

memories.root_cause: Unbounded full-file ingestion into prompt context inflates per-turn input tokens quadratically.
memories.countermeasure: Use get_file_outline/get_symbol first and read_file with bounded StartLine/EndLine (<= 150 lines) or virtualize large outputs.

memories.content: FastMCP server compatibility requires mcp>=1.28.1,<2.0.0; never create mcp/__init__.py in repo so PyPI mcp.server.fastmcp never gets shadowed.
Code-Mode MCP caps upfront @app.tool() schemas at <= 10 (currently 9) while exposing all 26 schema capabilities on demand via discover_mcp_tools() and mcp/tools_api/.

Infinite-Horizon 90%+ token loop uses preventative ContextVirtualizer FTS5 handles (ctx://), cli_compress noise filtering, DCP dedup/supersede, JetBrains observation masking, and epoch-aligned KV-cache preservation.
Convai Laya System-1 local triage (scripts/hooks/laya_gate.py + system1_triage) extracts root causes on CPU (<40ms) with zero LLM generation tokens.

memories.root_cause: Regex shell scanners matching < or > inside quoted inline scripts (e.g. python -c 'a < b') trigger scope violations.
memories.countermeasure: Use quote-aware shell token scanning in scripts/hooks/gravitas_action.py while still flagging double-quoted $(...) and backticks.

memories.root_cause: Naive \beval\( security regex flags PyTorch model.eval() inside legitimate ML skills.
memories.countermeasure: Use negative lookbehind (?<!\.)\b(?:eval|exec)\s*\( to ignore method attributes like model.eval().
